healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Equipment financing and leasing partner to hospitals and medical centers for radiosurgery and radiation therapy (outpatient procedures); not a direct care provider

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Radiation oncology and radiosurgery (Gamma Knife, radiation therapy)

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Revenue from hospital partners under equipment financing/leasing arrangements, typically per-procedure fees; hospitals bill payers

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Non-invasive outpatient radiosurgery and radiation therapy procedures, often single-session

notes: Company leases radiosurgery equipment to hospitals rather than delivering care directly; most provider-facet details are not in the evidence.
